paper_id: Edge Intelligence_ The Confluence of Edge Computing and Artificial Intelligence
title: Edge Intelligence: The Confluence of Edge Computing and Artificial Intelligence
motivation: 海量边缘数据无法回传云端,边缘智能是必然趋势
problem_framing: 将边缘智能分为AI for edge(使能边缘计算)和AI on edge(在边缘运行AI)两类进行系统梳理
key_insight: AI与边缘计算是双向互动关系:AI为边缘提供优化技术,边缘为AI提供场景与平台
method_signature: survey视角,用层次化路线图组织文献,QoE作为优化目标统一两个方向
evaluation_criteria: 无(综述论文,评价标准为覆盖度与分类清晰度)
evidence_for_taste: material in Edge Intelligence spans an immense and diverse spectrum
concepts are still unclear and questions remain unsolved
not simply combination of Edge Computing and AI
vanilla version of Federated Learning has strong demand for communication efficiency
thinking_moves: 用二分法将复杂领域拆解为对偶方向
从bottom-up和top-down双视角组织层次结构
QoE多维指标作为统一优化目标贯穿全文
识别协同设计机会(如learning-driven communication跨越通信与机器学习)
